{{Top|leg}}
'''Imperial travel permits''' were authorized waivers that allowed [[Starship/Legends|starships]] to enter restricted [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Star system/Legends|star systems]]. In the [[Brak sector/Legends|Brak sector]], Imperial travel permits were required to enter the [[Bacrana system/Legends|Bacrana]], [[Garia system/Legends|Garia]], [[Rehn system/Legends|Rehn]], and [[Skone system/Legends|Skone systems]].
